index.summary: The Jackson City Council held a special meeting on September 25, 2026, to handle year-end budget adjustments and several agreements. The council approved a $29,966,223 interdepartmental transfer to close out the FY2026 municipal budget, with funds moved from personnel services in police and public works and other categories to cover insurance, JTRAN, and other needs. The council also approved a $1,947,008 appropriation to the Jackson/Hinds Library System and accepted the Jackson Airport Authority budget for FY2026-2027. Additionally, the council authorized the mayor to execute a torch relay agreement with the Los Angeles Organizing Committee for the 2028 Olympics, making Jackson a host community, and approved a memorandum of agreement with the DEA for participation in a state and local law enforcement task force. All items passed 4-0.

topics.title: FY2026 Budget Revision
topics.note: Approved a $29,966,223 interdepartmental transfer to make final amendments to the FY2026 municipal budget, moving funds from various departments to cover shortfalls and close out the fiscal year.

topics.title: Police Department Personnel Savings
topics.note: The budget revision included transferring $2,220,648 from police department personnel services due to unfilled positions, which Councilman Foote noted means fewer officers on the street.

topics.title: Public Works Personnel Savings
topics.note: The budget revision included transferring $3,200,000 from public works personnel services due to unfilled positions, impacting road and drainage services.

topics.title: Operating Transfers to Outside Funds
topics.note: The budget revision included $3,700,000 in operating transfers from general government, representing money set aside for outside funds that was no longer needed.

topics.title: Landfill Sanitation Equipment
topics.note: The budget revision included $400,000 for landfill sanitation to purchase a dozer critical for getting the landfill fully online and complying with MDEQ regulations.

topics.title: Employee Group Insurance Fund
topics.note: The budget revision included $4,000,000 transferred into the employee group insurance fund because insurance costs were higher than expected.

topics.title: Franchise Cable Television Revenue Shortfall
topics.note: The budget revision decreased franchise cable television revenue by $500,000 due to lower-than-expected collections as more people stream instead of using cable.

topics.title: JTRAN Operating Transfers
topics.note: The budget revision included $4,000,000 in operating transfers to planning and development for balancing JTRAN, related to new buses.

topics.title: Audit Update
topics.note: CFO Jillian Caldwell reported that the city virtually met with auditors and is working to provide remaining items by next week, with the audit review to take a couple more weeks.

topics.title: Monthly Finance Committee Meetings
topics.note: Councilman Parkinson noted that the council has committed to monthly finance committee meetings starting after October actuals to monitor the budget throughout the year.

topics.title: Jackson/Hinds Library System Appropriation
topics.note: Approved an appropriation of $1,947,008 to the Jackson/Hinds Library System for fiscal year 2026-2027.

topics.title: Jackson Airport Authority Budget
topics.note: Accepted the budget of the Jackson Airport Authority for fiscal year 2026-2027.

topics.title: Olympic Torch Relay Agreement
topics.note: Authorized the mayor to execute a torch relay agreement with the Los Angeles Organizing Committee for the 2028 Olympics, making Jackson a host community and establishing a community task force.

topics.title: DEA Task Force Memorandum
topics.note: Authorized the mayor to enter into a memorandum of agreement with the U.S. Department of Justice, Drug Enforcement Administration, for participation in the DEA state and local law enforcement task force.
